mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges in creating effective topic clusters for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges include thorough keyword and intent research to map out pillar and cluster topics accurately, ensuring internal linking is logical and comprehensive without being overwhelming, and maintaining content quality and consistency across many pages. Another challenge is avoiding keyword cannibalization within the cluster itself and continuously updating content to remain current and authoritative. Additionally, accurately measuring the AEO impact, beyond just traditional SEO metrics, requires sophisticated analytics to track featured snippets, 'People Also Ask' appearances, and direct answer visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include accurate keyword research, logical internal linking, consistent content quality, avoiding cannibalization, ongoing content updates, and precise measurement of AEO impact.
